Rule.Name: Ensure mod_ssl and/or mod_nss is installed (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: mod_ssl and mod_nss are not installed or enabled.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Install and enable mod_ssl and/or mod_nss using apt and a2enmod.

Rule.Name: Ensure a valid trusted certificate is installed (Manual)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: No valid trusted SSL certificate is installed.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Install a valid SSL certificate signed by a trusted CA with an appropriate common name.
Rule.Correction: Manual installation required; obtain and install a trusted certificate.

Rule.Name: Ensure private key permissions are correctly set (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: The server's private key is not adequately protected.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Set ownership to root and permissions to 400 on the private key.

Rule.Name: Ensure TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 are disabled (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 protocols are enabled.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1, enabling only TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3.

Rule.Name: Ensure weak SSL/TLS ciphers are disabled (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Configure the SSLCipherSuite to disable weak ciphers.

Rule.Name: Ensure insecure SSL renegotiation is disabled (Automated)
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^SSLInsecureRenegotiation" /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf && sed -i 's|^SSLInsecureRenegotiation.*|SSLInsecureRenegotiation off|' /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf || echo 'SSLInsecureRenegotiation off' >> /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure SSL compression is disabled (Automated)
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^SSLCompression" /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf && sed -i 's|^SSLCompression.*|SSLCompression off|' /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf || echo 'SSLCompression off' >> /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure medium strength SSL/TLS ciphers are disabled (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Medium strength SSL/TLS ciphers are enabled.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Disable medium strength ciphers by adjusting the SSLCipherSuite.

Rule.Name: Ensure all HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Not all web content is forced to be accessed via HTTPS.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Configure rewrite rules to redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS.
Rule.Correction: echo "RewriteEngine On" >> /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf; echo "RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on" >> /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf; echo "RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]" >> /etc/apache2/sites-available/000-default.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure OCSP Stapling is enabled (Automated)
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Enable OCSP Stapling in the SSL configuration.
Rule.Correction: grep -q "^SSLOCSPStapling" /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf && sed -i 's|^#\?SSLOCSPStapling.*|SSLOCSPStapling On|' /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf || echo 'SSLOCSPStapling On' >> /etc/apache2/mods-available/ssl.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) is enabled (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is not enabled.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Configure HSTS by adding the Strict-Transport-Security header.
Rule.Correction: echo "Header always set Strict-Transport-Security \"max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains\"" >> /etc/apache2/conf-available/security.conf; service apache2 restart

Rule.Name: Ensure only cipher suites with forward secrecy are allowed (Automated)
Rule.NonCompliantComment: Cipher suites that do not provide forward secrecy are enabled.
Rule.CorrectiveComment: Configure the SSLCipherSuite to allow only ciphers that provide forward secrecy.
